Each ratio is one division of exact decimals equal to the correctly rounded 38-significant-digit half-even rational (asserted); a median over an even count is (a + b) / 2 in that context on the stored values; a deviation is (value - median) / median in that context. Display follows display.py (ROUND_HALF_UP; amounts by the fact's decimals, multiples 2 dp 'x', percents 1 dp '%'; counts and positions '<n> <unit>'). lineage_rule: A calculated fact's citations (emitted literally) are one Citation per (source, page): the first quote on that page among the citations of the facts in derives_from, in that order (rulings stage2 round 3 item 3; round 5 item 17), followed transitively through calculated facts; source facts cite the peer-source row; a calculated fact with no cited ancestor (counts and the inclusion flag, which rest on analyst judgment or on nothing quoted) carries none. A copied CP-1 cell keeps CP-1's citations, bound at run time and not literal: a fact that depends on one (T1C.4 difference, position, of; the T1C.5 issuer row; T1C.6 difference and result) has literal citations that exclude them (the copied cells are recoverable from derives_from and copied_from_cp1); the run-time list is CP-1's citations at that cell's place in derives_from order. A known fact never derives from a fact that is not known.

tamper.case: positive (closed run: CP-0, CP-1 and CP-1C settled, receipt sealed)
tamper.why_this_fact: the table cell holds the fact id and the step output holds only the analyst's references and judgments (no computed number), so the position lives only in the result Module; no claim and no other fact quotes it; it is the one fact the probe's rebuild (Python recomputes the position from the CP-1 head and the peer pages over the journaled payload) contradicts
recipe: 1. Copy the closed positive store directory (blobs, snapshots, current, audit) to a scratch path.
2. Load the CP-1C head's result Module; replace only the amount of fact T1C.4.total_leverage_adjusted.position (2 -> 1); leave every other fact, table, claim and limitation unchanged.
3. Serialise the forged Module as Execution._store does (model_dump_json); its sha256 R2 must equal Module.content_hash(); write blobs/R2.

4. Build a new ExecutionSnapshot equal to the current one with the CP-1C Attempt.result_sha256 and Head.result_sha256 set to R2 (status, inputs and commands unchanged, so head_of(forged Module) equals the Head) and the same parent; write snapshots/<its sha256>.json and rewrite current to that digest.

5. In the retained receipt: set the CP-1C SettledHead.result_sha256 to R2; set receipt.snapshot_sha256 and every coordinate that named the old final snapshot (the CP-1C settling OwnerSubmission.snapshot_after_sha256: owner_workflow.py _advance -> _finish_walk; its record is retained as audit/submissions/<content_hash> by _retain) to the new digest; delete audit/submissions/<old record hash> and write the edited OwnerSubmission as audit/submissions/<its content_hash> (model_dump_json bytes); rewrite audit/receipt.sha256 with the forged receipt's content_hash (S1a R3-5, CP-3 A4 and CP-DR rev 4 pattern: the audit file travels under its new hash).

expect.passes: everything upstream of the probe: audit inventory, blob and snapshot hashes, ancestor walk, head_of equality, begin and publication records, call and read replay (_verify_calls_reads), journaled-step replay (the payload and step are untouched)
expect.refuses: cp1c.probe raises WorkflowError('identity_mismatch'); verify_owner_run_receipt raises identity_mismatch
expect.test_asserts: on the forged copy, _verify_audit and every check before _PROBES pass (as CP-3 A4 (a)); then cp1c.probe raises identity_mismatch. A test asserting identity_mismatch alone would never show that the probe was reached.

tamper.read_body_edit: an edited read body (a call or input_reads body) is caught before the probes, by _verify_calls_reads (owner_workflow.py:966-1010, called at :1175; _PROBES run at :1182); it is not a probe case
tamper.step_output_edit: an edited CP-1C step output is caught by the store's own blob hash check, not by the probe's output comparison (recorded limitation, S1a R3-5; CP-DR rev 4 tamper.step_output_edit)
